# Sanchez Masonry

> Family-owned masonry and outdoor construction contractor based in San Antonio, Texas. Jose Sanchez and his team have 20+ years of experience building flagstone patios, retaining walls, outdoor fire pits, concrete work, and custom stonework. Rated 4.9 out of 5 from 55 Google reviews.

## Services

- Flagstone and Paver Patios — hand-laid flagstone, travertine, and paver patios with proper base prep and drainage
- Outdoor Fire Pits and Fireplaces — wood-burning fire pits and fireplaces built to code, stone or brick surrounds
- Retaining Walls — engineered retaining and garden walls for Texas soil and drainage
- Entry Masonry — stone mailbox pillars, columns, and entry features
- Concrete — driveways, walkways, footings, stamped and stained finishes
- Custom Masonry — outdoor kitchens, fireplaces, and one-of-a-kind stonework
